# searchstax_custom_jar (Resource)





## Import

Import an existing custom JAR with `account_name/deployment_uid/name`.

```shell
terraform import searchstax_custom_jar.example account_name/deployment_uid/name
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `deployment_uid` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `file_path` (String)
- `source_url` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
